Let Us buy Your Grain!
The Osage Co-op Elevator has a long-earned reputation of getting trucks back to the field. With 5 dump pits, 2 dryer set-ups, and 6 million bushels of storage, we have the ability to keep things moving.
Paired with the longest running, most experienced Grain Merchandiser in the area, you won’t find a better place to sell your crops.
Too far from Osage? Our fleet of trucks can help get your crop from the bin to market.
Call us today and let us help you with your marketing and logistical needs!
Call for More Information: (888)-732-3768

Grain Storage Policy
Corn Storage Rates
Warehouse Receipt:
18 cents minimum - 90 days. 13 cent per day thereafter, 53.75 cents 1st year, 47.45 cents thereafter per year. Moisture Content - 14%.
Grain Bank Rates:
6 cents minimum - 90 days. 13 cent per day thereafter, 41.75 cents 1st year, 47.45 cents thereafter per year. Moisture Content - 15%.
Price Later Rates:
18 cents minimum - 90 days. 13 cent per day thereafter, 53.75 cents 1st year. Moisture Content - 15%.
Drying Charges:
5.0 cents per point of moisture, 10 cents minimum; shrinkage - 1.45% per point of moisture removed.
All drying and /or storage charges will be deducted from the sale of the
grain and/or be charged to the customer’s account.
Soybean Storage Rates
Warehouse Receipt:
20 cents minimum - 90 days. 13 cent per day thereafter, 55.75 cents 1st year, 47.45 cents thereafter per year. Moisture Content - 13%.
Price Later Rates:
20 cents minimum - 90 days. 13 cent per day thereafter, 55.75 cents 1st year. Moisture Content - 13%.
Soybean Moisture Discount:
1.5% of the selling price per ½% of moisture over 13%.
Note: Soybeans that come in at 15% or higher will be priced out that day.
Moisture Averaging
Corn
15.5% moisture and below will be averaged.
Soybeans
14.0% moisture and below will be averaged.
Grain Bank Corn Sold:
Corn sold from grain bank or taken home unprocessed will revert back to our original warehouse receipt charges and moisture.
Condo Storage
Warehouse corn receipt at 14% moisture.
Polices Subject to Change with Posting.
